title: Functional user tests — sign in, failed sign in, password reset, sign out
notes: Intent-level steps, no selectors: selectors churn, intent does not. The probe resolves controls from the accessibility tree. 'verified' records the last real browser run.

steps: open the sign-in page
expect: an identifier field, a password field and a submit button are present
no console errors
no raw i18n key (core.*) is visible as page text
the password show/hide toggle reveals and re-hides the value
the form carries no action attribute and no method=post
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS — fields + toggle present, 0 console errors, no raw i18n keys, form has no action/method

steps: type a non-existent identifier (uiprobe-aaaa@example.invalid) and any password
submit
expect: the document does NOT navigate — submission is an XHR, not a page POST
the request goes to /auth/login and the response is JSON
an error message is shown in the feedback region, not a browser alert
the password field is cleared
the submit button returns from its busy state
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS — no navigation; XHR POST /auth/login -> 401; role=alert 'Invalid login or password.'; password field cleared, identifier kept

steps: fail a sign-in with one unknown identifier
fail a sign-in with a DIFFERENT unknown identifier
expect: both attempts return the same status
both show the identical message — nothing distinguishes a real account from an unknown one
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS — both 401, both 'Invalid login or password.'

steps: submit with both fields empty
expect: the page does not navigate
the user is told what is missing
no console error
scenarios.verified: not yet run in the browser

steps: enter a non-existent address (uiprobe-aaaa@example.invalid)
submit
expect: the document does NOT navigate
the same confirmation is shown as for a real address — no account enumeration
no console errors
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS — no navigation; XHR POST /auth/forgot -> 200; 'If an account exists for ...' (no enumeration); form replaced by the confirmation

steps: open the reset screen with an invalid token
attempt to set a new password
expect: the dead-link card renders INSTEAD of the password form
it offers a one-click way to request a new link
the page title reflects the expired state, not 'Set a new password'
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS after the TIGER-387 fix — was FAIL: the full password form used to render for a dead token and the refusal only arrived after the user typed it twice

steps: sign in with the credentials from tests/ui/credentials.local.json
wait for the redirect
expect: the client redirects to the server-chosen target (res.redirect), not a hardcoded path
the landed page renders with no console errors
the session heartbeat /auth/session returns JSON
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS — XHR POST /auth/login -> 200, client redirect to /account (the server-chosen role home, not a hardcoded path); 0 console errors on the landed page

steps: while signed in, go to sign out
then try to open an authenticated page
expect: the signed-out confirmation card renders
both of its links resolve (the sign-in button must reach the real login screen, not a CMS page that merely 200s)
the authenticated page is no longer reachable — the session is genuinely destroyed
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS — signed-out card renders; /account afterwards redirects to /auth/login, so the session is genuinely destroyed

steps: sign in as a plain `user` role
navigate directly to /admin
expect: the admin surface is refused
the user lands somewhere sane rather than on an error page
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS — /admin redirects to /account; ACL refuses without a 403 page

steps: mint a real password_reset challenge for the probe user
open the emailed link shape
set a new password
open the SAME link a second time
expect: the form renders for a live token (the TIGER-387 guard must not break real links)
the reset succeeds and signs the user straight in at the role home with ?pwreset=1
the second visit shows the dead-link card — single-use is enforced and surfaced early
scenarios.verified: 2026-10-24 PASS — all three, against a freshly minted token on tiger-dev
